rule: Coverage is stated per product, from the code constants and registries that govern it - never implied nationwide. scripts/audit_product_coverage.py validates this file against the code it describes, and a row may not lose its not_covered list. A reachable address or a registered source is not coverage.

products.geography: any named settlement or point in India, answered by the model grid cell with its distance stated
products.time: model forecast up to 7 days ahead; one task's window may not exceed 7 days
products.granularity: exact-window totals and ranges for precipitation, temperature, wind speed and relative humidity
products.cadence: refreshed by the ingestion worker per collected day

products.geography: any named settlement or point in India, answered by the nearest model cell with its distance stated
products.time: hourly values up to 48 hours per task
products.granularity: hourly precipitation, hourly precipitation probability, temperatures, wind, gusts, visibility and humidity
not_covered: windows beyond 48 hours in one task
a probability for a whole period

products.geography: any named settlement or point in India at the reanalysis cell
products.time: 1 to 7 whole IST days per request, published about 5 days behind; years from 1950 for the served models
products.granularity: daily reanalysis values on Indian calendar days
products.cadence: published by the source with about a five-day delay

products.geography: All India aggregate only; it describes no individual village or district
products.time: published annual and monthly records, 1901 to 2024
products.granularity: national rainfall and national mean temperature aggregates

products.geography: the historical districts the publication carries, resolved with their state
products.time: published annual and monthly district rainfall
products.granularity: one district's published rainfall rows with page, row and file provenance
not_covered: a district the publication does not carry

products.geography: IMD district warning geometry resolved by point-in-polygon for a named place
products.time: the day windows the current bulletin edition prints; freshness follows the latest fetched edition
products.granularity: district-day hazard and colour as printed; a separate CAP relay source assessment is reported beside it, never merged
not_covered: a district outside the published geometry

products.geography: the publisher's 698-entry district directory across the states and union territories; a listing is not an issuance, and a district's latest edition may be missing, stale or held
products.time: each edition's printed issue date, with currency measured against the retrieval date
products.granularity: crop and stage passages quoted from the district edition
products.cadence: as the publisher issues district editions
not_covered: a district the directory does not list
advice newer than the printed edition

products.geography: a verified sea grid cell within 50 km of a named coastal place; an inland place is not answered with a distant cell
products.time: the model wave forecast within the product's horizon
products.granularity: significant wave height, period and direction at the answering cell

products.geography: a verified GloFAS river cell within 50 km of the named place
products.time: daily UTC days within the product horizon
products.granularity: modelled discharge at the answering cell

products.geography: Indian ICAO airports with a currently valid report
products.time: the report's own validity; a stale METAR is dropped, a TAF must cover the asked window

products.geography: one point in India at the ensemble cells
products.granularity: member range and percentiles for temperature, precipitation and wind at the returned cells, one measure at a time

products.geography: a CAMS modelled cell for a named place
products.time: hourly modelled values within the product horizon
products.granularity: pollutant concentrations and the source's own US and European indices

products.geography: points where archived model runs and the ERA5 reference overlap
products.time: completed windows of 1 to 31 completed days, never inside the five-day reanalysis delay
products.granularity: bias, mean absolute error, root mean square error and correlation by lead time over matched hours
products.cadence: computed on request from archived runs
